headline: Vikings Trade QB J.J. McCarthy To Giants
summary: J.J. McCarthy’s tenure in Minnesota is coming to an end. The third-year quarterback will receive a fresh start in New York via an in-season trade. McCarthy is being dealt from the Vikings to the Giants, as first reported by The Ringer’s Tom Pelissero. Minnesota will receive a 2027 fifth-round pick in return. This deal (which is now official) […]

headline: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield To Miss At Least Three Games
summary: Monday brought about further news with respect to Baker Mayfield and the Buccaneers. Testing has yielded positive results, although missed time is still in store. Mayfield dislocated his thumb late in Sunday’s loss. An MRI revealed no fractures or ligament damage, per ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler. He adds a second opinion is being sought out in this case. […]

headline: Dolphins’ De’Von Achane Suffers ACL Tear
summary: 11:00pm: As expected, the Dolphins have placed Achane on injured reserve, per NFL Network’s Cameron Wolfe. 9:39am: De’Von Achane’s injury from Week 3 led to concerns about a lengthy absence. headline: Panthers CB Jaycee Horn Facing Extended Absence
summary: The Panthers may need to finish the 2026 season without their top cornerback. Jaycee Horn exited Sunday’s loss, and a lengthy absence is in store. Horn suffered a torn quad, NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports. An indefinite absence and a move to injured reserve will now be required. Rapoport adds a second opinion is being sought out […]

headline: QB3 Case Keenum, Bears defense shock Eagles in MNF rout
summary: Keenum stepped up big in a pressure situation and combined with a defensive gem to lead the Bears past the Eagles.

headline: Sirianni regrets reaction to hit on QB Hurts in Eagles' loss
summary: After a 27-7 loss to Chicago on Monday, Eagles coach Nick Sirianni expressed "remorse" over his reaction to a sideline hit by Bears linebacker D'Marco Jackson on Philadelphia's Jalen Hurts that temporarily knocked his quarterback out of the first half.
